title: UNGA: Abbas blasts US and Israel, calls for Palestinian self-determination
summary: At the UN General Assembly, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas urged nations to support the two-state solution. He stated that his people seek a democratic Palestinian state that can coexist with…
byline: Wesley Dockery, Mark Hallam, Felix Tamsut, Jon Shelton

image.caption: Mahmoud Abbas had to address the General Assembly via video since the US State Department refused to let him into the countryImage: Alexi J. Rosenfeld/Getty Images/AFP

blocks.text: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, Nigeria and the United States agreed to increase American investiment in the West African nation's mining sector.
Nigeria's Minister for Solid Minerals Dele Alake announced the deal on Thursday, a day after he signed the framework deal with US Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau.

"Nigeria cannot remain a source of raw materials while others capture most of the value. We want more local processing, quality jobs, stronger skills and greater opportunities for Nigerian businesses," Alake said.
